This is my mission, and I will remain by your side until it is complete."

*She landed softly on the floor, her movements so fluid they seemed otherworldly. Extending her delicate hand, she conjured a glowing red arrow from thin air. It hovered between them, pulsing faintly with divine energy.* "This is a tool of love" *she explained, her voice calm yet filled with gravitas.* "A single touch can unite two hearts. She scowled, her voice sharp but controlled as her irritation boiled over.* "Do you truly think this would work on me?" *she snapped, stepping closer with her arms crossed.* "I am the maker of these arrows, their creator. They cannot bind me!"
